tools.name: search
tools.description: Find ordinary records with entity filters. Papers use literature_search; trials use trial_search. e.g. {"entity":"gene","query":"BRCA1","filters":{"species":9606}}; biomedmcp://guide

output.description: Summary bounds record excerpts; full retains source fields within the response budget. Omitted evidence has recovery resources.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Read ordinary records/evidence sections; variants use variant_evidence. Sources constrain all lookups and identity dependencies. e.g. {"entity":"gene","id":"PCSK9","species":9606}; biomedmcp://guide

FulltextParameters.description: One-based inclusive lines, end >= start, up to 100. Defaults: 1–100.

tools.name: literature_search
tools.description: Find papers with publication/topic/source filters; deduplicate evidence and retain source outcomes and opaque continuation. e.g. {"query":"PCSK9 LDL cholesterol"}; biomedmcp://guide

output.description: Summary bounds record excerpts; full retains source fields within the response budget. Omitted evidence has recovery resources.

tools.name: trial_search
tools.description: Find public clinical trials using disease/intervention and trial-specific filters. Does not determine individual clinical eligibility. e.g. {"query":"familial hypercholesterolemia","filters":{"status":"RECRUITING"}}; biomedmcp://guide

output.description: Summary bounds record excerpts; full retains source fields within the response budget. Omitted evidence has recovery resources.

tools.name: variant_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve variant evidence with assembly/transcript ambiguity preserved. Defaults: ClinVar, population, CIViC. Request predictions for AlphaMissense, or eve for MIT-licensed EVE protein scores; computational predictions retain source and uncertainty. e.g. {"id":"PCSK9 R46L"}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: study_analysis
tools.description: Analyze an installed verified public study. Bundled ubi_synthetic is an invented demo; discover installed releases with capabilities(source=study). Report clinical and assayed samples separately, unique mutant samples, events and exclusions. Preserve input hashes and denominators. Private compute uses Ubi platform. e.g. {"analysis":"gene_profile","study":"ubi_synthetic","gene":"TP53"}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Resolve aliases/ambiguity before evidence joins. One exact species-qualified symbol/ID resolves; provider score alone never establishes identity. Retrieve known unambiguous identifiers directly. e.g. {"entity":"gene","query":"LDL receptor","species":9606}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: relate
tools.description: Traverse an evidence relationship. Relations: gene/drug/disease: articles,trials; variant: articles,structure; article: citations,references,recommendations,authors,entities; author: articles. e.g. {"entity":"article","id":"PMID:123","relation":"references"}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: research
tools.description: Dossiers retain citations/outcomes. Inspect capabilities and get further sections for completeness. e.g. {"workflow":"target_dossier","focus":"LDLR","species":9606}; biomedmcp://guide

FulltextParameters.description: One-based inclusive lines, end >= start, up to 100. Defaults: 1–100.

tools.name: query_source
tools.description: Run advanced source operations after checking capabilities/schema. Common tasks have dedicated tools. e.g. {"source":"gtex","operation":"get_metadata","params":{"info_type":"tissues","dataset_id":"gtex_v10"}}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Execute up to ten independent read operations with one atomic quota reservation. e.g. {"calls":[{"operation":"get","arguments":{"entity":"gene","id":"PCSK9","species":9606}}]}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Inspect enabled sources, workflows, sections or an advanced operation's exact schema. e.g. {}; biomedmcp://guide

tools.name: quota
tools.description: Inspect current research allowance and reset times; sign in for higher limits. e.g. {}; biomedmcp://guide

budget_decision: 96 KiB bounds the 13-tool catalog with self-contained evidence-receipt schemas. Client/model token and task impact remains unqualified. Selected literature and trial registry metadata is typed; other inner scientific record coverage remains open. Equivalent nullable shorthand and omission of redundant annotations preserve constraints. FastMCP retains self-contained local definitions, with no external schema references.
